# Falcon Project AI

> Developer utilities for JSON contracts, API responses, and AI-agent output validation.

## Product hub

- [All products and marketplace listings](https://falconprojectai-arch.github.io/falcon-ai-decision-engine/products/marketplace-hub.html): current catalog with verified publication states.

## Agensi skill listings — approved and live

All nine free skills below were rechecked on 14 November 2026 and remain approved and live in the creator dashboard. The dashboard reports zero uses, ratings, and reviews for all nine. Do not treat a live listing as usage or revenue.

- [Lead Follow-up Strategist](https://agensi.io/skills/lead-follow-up-strategist): consent-aware follow-up drafts for genuine inbound leads; draft-only.
- [Quote-to-Booking Workflow Planner](https://agensi.io/skills/quote-to-booking-workflow-planner): structure enquiries, quote preparation and booking next steps; human approval required.
- [JSON Contract Tester](https://agensi.io/skills/json-contract-tester): test API/agent JSON outputs against a documented schema subset.
- [Dev & Agent Toolbox](https://agensi.io/skills/dev-agent-toolbox): workflow guide for browser-based developer utilities.
- [LocalBiz FollowUp](https://agensi.io/skills/localbiz-followup): local browser lead tracker for small businesses and online sellers.
- [StockPulse](https://agensi.io/skills/stockpulse): local inventory, reorder threshold and gross-margin tracker.
- [MCPGuard Lite](https://agensi.io/skills/mcpguard-lite): heuristic local review of MCP/agent JSON configuration; not a full security audit.
- [ExpenseSnap](https://agensi.io/skills/expensesnap): local time and expense log with CSV/JSON export.
- [CronPulse](https://agensi.io/skills/cronpulse): offline analysis of exported scheduled-job and agent run logs.

## Primary products

- [JSON Contract Tester — free browser tool](https://falconprojectai-arch.github.io/falcon-ai-decision-engine/products/json-contract-tester/): Validate JSON examples against a documented schema subset locally in the browser. Inputs are processed in the browser and are not uploaded by this tool.
- [JSON Contract Tester API](https://json-contract-tester-api.falcon-project-ai.workers.dev/): Stateless machine-to-machine endpoint for validating 1–10 JSON outputs in one batch.
  - Endpoint: `POST https://json-contract-tester-api.falcon-project-ai.workers.dev/v1/validate-batch`
  - Price: 0.005 USDC per batch on Base Mainnet (`eip155:8453`).
  - Payment: x402 v2; unpaid valid requests return HTTP 402 with a `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` challenge.
  - No API key or account is required; an x402-compatible client and a wallet able to authorize Base USDC payments are required for paid calls.
  - [Buyer quickstart — Node.js and Python](https://github.com/falconprojectai-arch/falcon-ai-decision-engine/blob/main/products/json-contract-tester-api/BUYER_QUICKSTART.md)
  - [OpenAPI 3.1 JSON](https://json-contract-tester-api.falcon-project-ai.workers.dev/openapi.json)
  - [x402 v2 manifest](https://json-contract-tester-api.falcon-project-ai.workers.dev/.well-known/x402.json)
  - [No-payment preflight](https://falconprojectai-arch.github.io/falcon-ai-decision-engine/products/json-contract-tester-api/payment-preflight.html)
- [Dev & Agent Toolbox](https://falconprojectai-arch.github.io/falcon-ai-decision-engine/products/dev-agent-toolbox/): Free developer utilities for API and agent workflows.
- [LocalBiz FollowUp](https://falconprojectai-arch.github.io/falcon-ai-decision-engine/products/localbiz-followup/): local-first lead and customer enquiry tracker for shops, service providers and online sellers, now including last-contact date, next action and notes; no cloud sync, background alerts or automatic message sending.
- [StockPulse](https://falconprojectai-arch.github.io/falcon-ai-decision-engine/products/stockpulse/): manual SKU inventory, reorder-threshold and gross-margin estimator with local browser storage.
- [MCPGuard Lite](https://falconprojectai-arch.github.io/falcon-ai-decision-engine/products/mcpguard-lite/): local heuristic review of MCP/agent JSON configuration; not a full security audit.
- [ExpenseSnap](https://falconprojectai-arch.github.io/falcon-ai-decision-engine/products/expensesnap/): local time and expense logger with project summaries and CSV/JSON export.
- [CronPulse](https://falconprojectai-arch.github.io/falcon-ai-decision-engine/products/cronpulse/): offline analyzer for exported scheduled-job and AI-agent run history; no live monitoring or auto-restart.

## API contract

Request JSON:
- `schema`: JSON Schema object using the supported subset.
- `outputs`: array of 1–10 items, each with `id` and `json`.

Response JSON includes:
- `valid`: whether every sample passed.
- `summary`: total, passed, failed.
- `results[]`: per-sample PASS/FAIL and structured diagnostics.
- Error details include JSON Pointer paths such as `instancePath`, `schemaPath`, `keyword`, `expected`, and `actual`.

Supported subset:
- `type`, `required`, `properties`, `additionalProperties: false`, `items`, `enum`, `const`, numeric bounds, string length, and array length.
- The hosted API rejects `pattern`.
- Not full JSON Schema: no `$ref`/`$defs`, composition keywords, or format assertions.
- Limits: 64 KiB request body, 1–10 samples, 32 nesting levels, 2,000 total JSON nodes, and 100 diagnostics per sample.

## Safe use

- Never submit secrets, personal data, credentials, or confidential production payloads.
- Inspect the live x402 challenge's network, token, amount, and recipient before authorizing any payment.
- A HTTP 402 challenge or directory listing is not proof of a completed sale. Count a sale only after a successful 2xx response and a verified settlement receipt.
- The API is experimental; no uptime SLA or full JSON Schema conformance is claimed.

## Affiliate disclosures

The infrastructure guides include clearly disclosed referral links to [SwiftNodes](https://swiftnodes.io/affiliates) and [StableDomains](https://stabledomains.net/affiliates). SwiftNodes' public page advertises 20% recurring commission, a 30-day hold, USDC on Base/Arbitrum/Polygon and a $50 monthly minimum. StableDomains' official pages currently conflict: the main affiliate/program pages say 10% of margin, while the referral-link/developer pages still say $0.60 per .com and $0.51 per .xyz; shared terms include 30-day attribution, weekly USDC on Base and a $5 minimum. Verify the current dashboard/provider terms before relying on a StableDomains commission amount. No conversion or commission is verified; no provider performance is claimed to have been independently benchmarked by this project.
